calibration_statement: Version 3.4.1 is a prototype/pre-validation physics-based QIUP simulator. The implemented physical model and software verification tests do not constitute experimental calibration or validation. Calibration against the actual laboratory pump, nonlinear crystals, optical relays, SLM, and detector is required before the system can be classified as a validated digital twin.

status_meanings.validated_fixed: value fixed by profile validation (perturbations rejected)
status_meanings.metadata_only: recorded in run metadata; no array change detected in audit scenarios
status_meanings.not_consumed: no effect detected in audit scenarios

column_meanings.configurations: profiles in which the field changes simulated arrays (traced, not hand-written)
column_meanings.configurations_fixed_by_validation: profiles whose validation rejects every perturbation
column_meanings.configurations_metadata_only: profiles where the value is recorded but no array change was detected
column_meanings.profile_defining: every profile's validation fixes the value (selector owned by the configuration)
column_meanings.documented_dependency_v3_4: hand-written applicability in the Version 3.4 inventory (historical)
column_meanings.parameter_role: fixed | sampled | derived | calibration-dependent | selector | metadata
column_meanings.calibration_status: experimental calibration status; no value in this file is a laboratory measurement

parameters.default: Physical beam default: pump_waist_um=250 µm (allowed 100–350), pixel_um=16 µm, M=1, crystal L=2 mm (2–20). σ_SPDC = M·σ/p; NF uses P07/P10 Δ_V/√2, FF uses m_i f_u λ_i/(2π w_p).

profile_defaults.A: Reference inventory and reported temperatures/poling. The conditional Gaussian spatial model and ideal unit pump path transmissions are software assumptions pending apparatus calibration; no end-to-end experimental validation is claimed.
profile_defaults.B: Reference near-field Michelson topology with a reflective SLM replacing the idler end mirror. Spatial propagation is reduced order and high-gain spatial imaging remains provisional.
profile_defaults.C: Reference far-field Michelson topology with a reflective SLM replacing the idler end mirror. Fourier-plane geometry is explicit; spatial propagation is reduced order and awaits apparatus calibration.
profile_defaults.D: Two independent ppKTP sources in a near-field image-plane relay. The conditional-Gaussian spatial model is reduced order; no end-to-end experimental validation is claimed.
